Metta anisaṃsa(ya)sutta
Bud. Pāli. on merits of meditation an. friendliness; in prose; included in the Paritta an. also in Aṅguttara Nikāya, Ekādaśanipāta. In Tib. Kandjour (Mdo.

) this sūtra is prefixed to the Metta Sutta (from Jātaka 538) an. given a. a sūtra called Maitrībhāvanāsūtra.
Colombo D.

(in a collection). 1149.
For a. Eng. transl., see Traductions de Gogerly, J.

Mettabhāvanā
Bud. Pāli. Bud. meditation on friendliness. Colombo D.

Mettasutta
Bud. Pāli. In verse, included in Paritta a. also in Jātaka 538 (where it is called Dasa-Mitta-pūjaka-Gāthā). In the Tib. Kandjour (Mdo. XXX 18); this sūtra is joined with the Metta-anisaṃsa(ya)sutta(of Paritta) [Page159-a. an. the two together called Maitrībhāvanāsūtra.
For a. Eng. transl., see Traductions de Gogerly, J.

.

Mettānusmṛti
Bud. Pāli. Bud. reflection an. meditation on friendliness. Colombo D.
